questions.e: Anthropic priced its Nasdaq IPO at $83 a share, above its planned range, and raised about $81 billion, passing SpaceX's roughly $75 billion IPO as the biggest ever.
questions.h: An AI lab that began trading on Nasdaq on Thursday.
questions.q: Which company completed the largest IPO on record this week, topping SpaceX's June offering?

questions.e: A drop of 10% from a recent high is a correction, while 20% is the usual bear-market line. The S&P 500's record high was set on Oct 6.
questions.h: Less severe than a bear market.
questions.q: On Friday, Nov 20, the S&P 500 closed more than 10% below its record high. What is that called?

questions.e: The tech-heavy Nasdaq is the most exposed to AI and chip stocks, which led the sell-off. It fell more than 10% for the week.
questions.h: The most tech-heavy of the big indexes.
questions.q: Which major U.S. index erased all of its 2026 gains on Friday after falling more than 5% in one day?

questions.e: Revenue more than doubled from a year earlier, led by about $108 billion from data centers. Even so, the stock fell sharply later in the week.
questions.h: Revenue more than doubled from a year ago.
questions.q: Nvidia reported third-quarter (fiscal 2027) revenue of about how much on Nov 17?

questions.e: Kress, Nvidia's longtime CFO, became interim CEO while keeping her finance role. The board is searching for a permanent CEO.
questions.h: She was already Nvidia's chief financial officer.
questions.q: Who is serving as Nvidia's interim CEO after Jensen Huang resigned on Nov 12?

questions.e: The vote was 10-2. The two dissenters, Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack, wanted a quarter-point increase.
questions.q: The Fed held rates at its Oct 27-28 meeting. What target range for the federal funds rate did it keep?

questions.e: Officials cited inflation running well above the 2% goal. Higher rates raise borrowing costs across the economy.
questions.h: Two officials had already voted for this in October.
questions.q: Minutes of the Fed's October meeting, released Nov 18, showed almost all officials saw what as likely appropriate?

questions.e: Claims rose by 1,000 from the prior week and stayed low by historical standards. Low claims suggest few layoffs.
questions.q: Initial jobless claims for the week ending Nov 14 came in at about what level?

questions.e: Walmart's revenue rose about 5% to $188.8 billion, and global e-commerce sales grew 17%. Raising guidance signals management expects a stronger year.
questions.h: It was good news for shareholders.
questions.q: What did Walmart do with its full-year outlook when it reported third-quarter results this week?

questions.e: Markets close for Thanksgiving and reopen Friday for a shortened session ending at 1 p.m. ET. Key inflation (PCE) and GDP data arrive Wednesday.
questions.q: U.S. stock markets will be closed on which day next week?
